```{r sv-info}
# Built from the caller VCF, so it survives a missing VEP SV VCF
if (is.null(sv_table) || nrow(sv_table) == 0) {
  section_notice("No somatic structural variants detected.")
}
# Whitelist-rescued rows (Severus INFO/WL_RESCUE) are hidden until shown; the choice is shared
# with the key findings and the circos labels (window.SV_SHOW_RESCUED, key_findings.js)
sv_rescued = sv_is_rescued(sv_table)
n_sv_rescued = sum(sv_rescued)
```

```{r sv-bnd-circos}
# Breakend circos: R selects and serialises the data, assets/js/bnd_circos.js draws it so it re-lays-out per filter (see R/circos_bnd.R)
bnd_res = NULL
bnd_rescued_left_out = 0L
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  bnd_res = tryCatch({
    # One filtered set feeds both calls
    bnd_drawn = bnd_links(sv_table, chromosomes)
    # Over the payload cap with rescued rows: draw the default (non-rescued) view only
    if (nrow(bnd_drawn) > BND_CIRCOS_MAX_LINKS && n_sv_rescued > 0) {
      bnd_pass = bnd_links(sv_table[!sv_rescued], chromosomes)
      bnd_rescued_left_out = nrow(bnd_drawn) - nrow(bnd_pass)
      bnd_drawn = bnd_pass
    }
    bnd_circos_data(bnd_drawn,
                    bnd_panel_genes(bnd_drawn, params$all_panels),
                    cytobands, chrom_lens, chromosomes)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Breakend circos failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
}

if (!is.null(bnd_res) && !is.null(bnd_res$data)) {
  legend_item = function(swatch, var, label) {
    tags$div(class = "circos-legend__item",
             tags$span(class = paste0("circos-swatch--", swatch),
                       style = paste0("--_swatch: var(", var, ")")),
             label)
  }
  tagList(
    # The chromosome count is filled in by the plot, since it changes with the filter.
    tags$p(class = "circos-eyebrow",
           tags$span(id = "bnd-eyebrow", "Breakends"),
           " · select a row below to highlight its arc"),
    tags$div(class = "bnd-circos", id = "bnd-circos"),
    tags$div(class = "circos-legend",
      tags$div(class = "circos-legend__group",
        tags$div(class = "circos-legend__title", "Breakend circos"),
        legend_item("arc", "--circos-bnd",          "Rearrangement"),
        legend_item("arc", "--circos-bnd-selected", "Selected in the table"),
        legend_item("bar", "--circos-bnd-gene",     "Panel gene")
      )
    ),
    tags$p(class = "bnd-circos-caption", tags$span(id = "bnd-shown-count"))
  )
} else if (!is.null(bnd_res)) {
  section_notice(bnd_res$reason)
}
```

```{r sv-prepare, results='asis'}
# Column positions published from R, not scraped from the header
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  sv_display = copy(sv_table)
  # Populated client-side by the panel filter (svPanelHits()), including on load
  sv_display[, panel_hit := ""]
  # Readable locus/size/gene columns; the raw bedpe columns stay (hidden, exported, read by the JS). See sv_display_columns()
  sv_display = cbind(sv_display, sv_display_columns(sv_display, chromosomes))
  # Padfoot columns exist only when a Padfoot file was found (R/sections/sv.R)
  sv_padfoot_cols = intersect(PADFOOT_COLS, names(sv_display))
  setcolorder(sv_display, intersect(c("id", "panel_hit", "svclass", "svtype",
                                      "locus", "size", "genes",
                                      "vaf", "support", "filter", "wl_rescue",
                                      "consequence", "impact",
                                      sv_padfoot_cols, "caller"), names(sv_display)))
  cat("<script>window.SV_COLS = ", js_col_index_map(names(sv_display)), ";</script>\n",
      sep = "")

  # Tickbox facet values (facet_filter.js), emitted after setcolorder; a column with one value
  # (`caller` for a single-caller run) keeps its plain text box — js_facet_defs() skips it
  sv_facet_cols = c("svclass", "svtype", "impact", "consequence", "caller",
                    intersect("padfoot_impact", sv_padfoot_cols),
                    if (n_sv_rescued > 0) "filter")
  cat("<script>window.SV_FACET_COLS = ", js_vec(sv_facet_cols), ";</script>\n", sep = "")
  cat("<script>window.SV_FACETS = ",
      js_facet_defs(sv_display,
                    cols   = sv_facet_cols,
                    seps   = c(consequence = ","),
                    levels = list(impact = IMPACT_LEVELS)),
      ";</script>\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r sv-rescue-toggle, results='asis'}
# Rescued rows are filtered by one more ext.search predicate, pushed before the panel and facet
# predicates, so the facet counts and the breakend circos measure the shown rows only
if (n_sv_rescued > 0) {
  fmt_n0 = function(x) formatC(as.integer(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
  cat(sprintf(paste0('<p class="sv-rescue-toggle"><label><input type="checkbox" id="sv-show-rescued"> ',
                     'Show the %s whitelist-rescued call%s</label> ',
                     '<span class="sv-rescue-toggle__note">%s of %s rows are calls Severus kept only because ',
                     'they lie in the whitelist regions (<code>WL_RESCUE</code>); hidden by default.</span></p>\n'),
              fmt_n0(n_sv_rescued), if (n_sv_rescued == 1) "" else "s",
              fmt_n0(n_sv_rescued), fmt_n0(nrow(sv_table))))
  cat(r"----(<script>
(function () {
  if (!window.jQuery || !$.fn.dataTable) return;
  $.fn.dataTable.ext.search.push(function (settings, searchData, index, rowData) {
    if (settings.nTable !== window.svTableElem || window.SV_SHOW_RESCUED) return true;
    const cols = window.SV_COLS || {};
    const k = cols["wl_rescue"];
    const v = k === undefined ? null : (rowData || searchData)[k];
    return v === null || v === undefined || v === "";
  });
  function sync() {
    const box = document.getElementById("sv-show-rescued");
    if (box) box.checked = !!window.SV_SHOW_RESCUED;
    if (window.svTableElem) $(window.svTableElem).DataTable().draw();
  }
  document.addEventListener("change", function (e) {
    if (!e.target || e.target.id !== "sv-show-rescued") return;
    if (window.keyFindings && window.keyFindings.setShowRescued)
      window.keyFindings.setShowRescued(e.target.checked);
  });
  document.addEventListener("sv-rescue-change", sync);
})();
</script>
)----")
}
```

```{r sv-table}
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  idx0 = function(nm) which(names(sv_display) == nm) - 1L

  # Truncate the display only; sort/search/export renderings return the full list
  gene_render = JS(
    "function(data, type) {",
    "  if (type !== 'display' || !data) return data;",
    "  const g = String(data).split(',');",
    "  if (g.length <= 6) return data;",
    "  return '<span title=\"' + String(data).replace(/\"/g, '') + '\">' +",
    "         g.slice(0, 6).join(',') + ' +' + (g.length - 6) + ' more</span>';",
    "}")

  # Same predicate as the row filter. Agreement is not free, though: this runs once per row
  # node, so redraw() in per_sample.qmd has to invalidate() for a ticked panel to reach the
  # cells of rows that were already drawn
  panel_hit_render = JS(
    "function(data, type, row) {",
    "  return window.svPanelHitLabel ? window.svPanelHitLabel(row, window.SV_COLS) : '';",
    "}")

  # Sort `locus`/`size` on their hidden numeric keys; display/filter/export keep the readable string
  orthogonal_render = function(key) JS(
    "function(data, type, row) {",
    "  if (type !== 'sort' && type !== 'type') return data;",
    "  const cols = window.SV_COLS || {};",
    sprintf("  const k = cols['%s'];", key),
    "  return k === undefined ? data : row[k];",
    "}")

  # Hidden, not dropped: the JS by-name lookups and the CSV export read these columns
  # svtype_raw too: it differs from svtype only for a SAVANA pair typed from BP_NOTATION (footnote)
  hidden = intersect(c("chrom_a", "pos_a", "chrom_b", "pos_b", "gene_a", "gene_b",
                       "sv_len", "size_bp", "locus_sort", "svtype_raw",
                       # FILTER / WL_RESCUE say something only when a row was rescued
                       if (n_sv_rescued == 0) c("filter", "wl_rescue")), names(sv_display))

  exp_opts = list(orthogonal = "export",
                  columns    = seq_len(ncol(sv_display)) - 1L)

  dtbl = DT::datatable(
    sv_display,
    rownames   = FALSE,
    filter     = "top",
    elementId  = "sv-table",
    # Explicit selection: none. The breakend circos owns row selection below
    selection  = "none",
    extensions = c("Buttons", "Scroller"),
    options    = list(
      dom       = "Bfrtip",
      # "export" falls through to the full readable string; the explicit column list keeps the hidden raw columns in the download
      buttons   = list(list(extend = "copy", exportOptions = exp_opts),
                       list(extend = "csv",  exportOptions = exp_opts)),
      scrollX   = TRUE,
      scrollY   = "350px",
      scroller  = TRUE,
      deferRender = TRUE,
      pageLength = 25,
      columnDefs = list(
        list(targets = idx0("panel_hit"), render = panel_hit_render),
        list(targets = c(idx0("genes"), idx0("padfoot_genes")), render = gene_render),
        list(targets = idx0("locus"),     render = orthogonal_render("locus_sort")),
        list(targets = idx0("size"),      render = orthogonal_render("size_bp")),
        list(targets = vapply(hidden, idx0, integer(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
             visible = FALSE)
      ),
      initComplete = JS("function() { window.svTableElem = this.api().table().node(); }")
    )
  ) |>
    DT::formatStyle(
      columns = "svtype",
      target  = "cell",
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
        c("DEL",     "DUP",     "INV",     "INS",     "BND",     "sBND"),
        c("#dbeafe", "#dcfce7", "#fef9c3", "#fee2e2", "#f3e8ff", "#f3e8ff")
      )
    )
  # Padfoot's high-impact classes (HIGH_ONCO, HIGH_TSG, ...): the set is open-ended, so tint
  # whichever HIGH* values this table actually carries
  rescue_vals = sort(unique(sv_display$wl_rescue[sv_rescued]))
  if (length(rescue_vals) > 0) {
    dtbl = DT::formatStyle(dtbl, columns = "wl_rescue", target = "row",
                           fontStyle = DT::styleEqual(rescue_vals, rep("italic", length(rescue_vals))))
  }
  pf_high = if ("padfoot_impact" %in% names(sv_display))
              sort(unique(grep("^HIGH", sv_display$padfoot_impact, value = TRUE))) else character(0)
  if (length(pf_high) > 0) {
    dtbl = DT::formatStyle(dtbl, columns = "padfoot_impact", target = "cell",
                           backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(pf_high, rep("#fee2e2", length(pf_high))))
  }
  dtbl
}
```

```{r sv-bnd-circos-js, results='asis'}
# Cross-link table and circos: this owns row selection; row identity comes from the DataTables API (Scroller recycles <tr>s), so the class is re-applied per draw; every filter change redraws from window.BND_DATA
if (!is.null(bnd_res) && !is.null(bnd_res$data)) {
  cat("<script>\n")
  cat(r"----(
(function () {
  const SELECTED = new Set();
  // null until the first sync: everything counts as visible.
  let visibleIds = null;
  let visibleGenes = new Set();

  const table = () => (window.svTableElem ? $(window.svTableElem).DataTable() : null);
  const host = () => document.getElementById("bnd-circos");

  function rowId(row) {
    const cols = window.SV_COLS || {};
    return cols["id"] === undefined ? null : String(row[cols["id"]]);
  }

  // Panel genes per row from the same predicate as the panel_hit cell; labels are "GENE (side, how)", the gene name ends at " ("
  function rowGenes(row) {
    if (!window.svPanelHits) return [];
    return window.svPanelHits(row, window.SV_COLS)
      .map((lab) => lab.split(" (")[0])
      .join(",")
      .split(",")
      .map((g) => g.trim().toUpperCase())
      .filter((g) => g.length > 0);
  }

  // Redraw for the current filter and selection; untouched chromosomes leave the plot
  function apply() {
    if (!window.bndCircos) return;
    const stats = window.bndCircos.render(host(), visibleIds, visibleGenes, SELECTED);
    caption(stats);
  }

  function caption(stats) {
    const total = (window.BND_DATA && window.BND_DATA.links)
      ? window.BND_DATA.links.length : stats.arcs;
    const eyebrow = document.getElementById("bnd-eyebrow");
    if (eyebrow) {
      eyebrow.textContent = "Breakends · " + stats.chroms + " chromosome" +
                            (stats.chroms === 1 ? "" : "s");
    }
    const el = document.getElementById("bnd-shown-count");
    if (!el) return;
    const parts = [stats.arcs + " of " + total + " arc" + (total === 1 ? "" : "s") + " shown"];
    if (stats.genes > 0) parts.push(stats.genes + " panel gene" + (stats.genes === 1 ? "" : "s"));
    if (SELECTED.size > 0) parts.push(SELECTED.size + " selected");
    el.textContent = parts.join(" · ");
  }

  // Re-apply the selected class on every draw (Scroller rebuilds <tr> nodes)
  function paintRows() {
    const t = table();
    if (!t) return;
    $(t.table().body()).find("tr").each(function () {
      const d = t.row(this).data();
      if (!d) return;
      const id = rowId(d);
      $(this).toggleClass("bnd-selected", id !== null && SELECTED.has(id));
    });
  }

  window.bndSyncFilter = function () {
    const t = table();
    if (!t) return;
    const ids = new Set();
    const genes = new Set();
    t.rows({ search: "applied" }).data().each(function (row) {
      const id = rowId(row);
      if (id !== null) ids.add(id);
      rowGenes(row).forEach((g) => genes.add(g));
    });
    visibleIds = ids;
    visibleGenes = genes;
    apply();
    paintRows();
  };

  $(document).on("click", "#sv-table tbody tr", function () {
    const t = table();
    if (!t) return;
    const d = t.row(this).data();
    if (!d) return;
    const id = rowId(d);
    if (id === null) return;
    if (SELECTED.has(id)) SELECTED.delete(id); else SELECTED.add(id);
    $(this).toggleClass("bnd-selected", SELECTED.has(id));
    apply();
  });

  // Covers the per-column search boxes too, which do not go through redraw().
  $(document).on("draw.dt", function (e) {
    if (e.target === window.svTableElem) window.bndSyncFilter();
  });

  // Draw once immediately rather than waiting for the table's first draw.dt
  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", apply);
  } else {
    apply();
  }
})();
)----")
  cat("\n</script>\n")
}
```

```{r sv-footnote}
# Provenance footnote: where the breakend symbols came from, and which panel matching mode, reference and windows are active
if (!is.null(sv_table) && nrow(sv_table) > 0) {
  rel = function(p) sample_rel_path(p, sample_dir)

  # One HTML string, not a tagList (htmltools' newlines would render as " ,")
  code = function(x) paste0("<code>", htmltools::htmlEscape(x), "</code>")

  # A panel carrying `applies_to` filters the two tables on different gene sets, which is
  # otherwise invisible: a reader seeing IGH in panel_hit but never in the small-variant
  # table has no way to tell that apart from a broken filter.
  scope_note = function(p) {
    if (!isTRUE(p$has_scopes)) return(NULL)
    n_snv = length(unlist(p$genes_snv))
    n_sv  = length(unlist(p$genes_sv))
    n_all = length(unlist(p$genes))
    # An all-"both" column is not a split, and saying "140 of 140 ... and 140" is noise
    if (n_snv == n_all && n_sv == n_all) return(NULL)
    sprintf(paste("This panel is <strong>scoped per table</strong> (%s column): %s of its %s",
                  "genes filter small variants and %s filter SVs, %s of them both. A gene",
                  "scoped to one table not appearing in the other is by design."),
            code("applies_to"), n_snv, n_all, n_sv, n_snv + n_sv - n_all)
  }

  # One note per registered panel, hidden unless ticked (updatePanelNotes() toggles `hidden`)
  panel_body = function(p) {
    paste(c(.panel_mode_body(p), scope_note(p)), collapse = " ")
  }

  .panel_mode_body = function(p) {
    if (isTRUE(p$has_coords)) {
      sprintf(paste("Panel %s matches on <strong>breakend coordinates</strong> (%s intervals,",
                    "within %s of either breakend of a BND or %s of the span of any other",
                    "type)%s Each %s entry names the gene, the side it matched on (%s, %s,",
                    "or %s for a contiguous type), and then either %s — the breakend or span",
                    "overlaps the gene itself — or the distance to it. Those windows are wide,",
                    "so a hit is not on its own a disrupted gene: read the second token."),
              code(basename(as.character(p$path)[1])), length(unlist(p$start)),
              fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND), fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_OTHER),
              if (nzchar(as.character(p$reference)[1]))
                paste0(", built on ", as.character(p$reference)[1], ".")
              else paste(", whose reference is unverified — the panel declares none, so",
                         "nothing checks it against this report's."),
              code("panel_hit"), code("A"), code("B"), code("span"), code("direct"))
    } else {
      sprintf(paste("Panel %s carries no coordinates, so SVs are matched on <strong>gene",
                    "symbol</strong> only: a breakend VEP did not annotate cannot match,",
                    "whatever it is near. Every %s entry therefore reads %s — a symbol sits",
                    "on the breakend itself, and there is no distance to report. Add %s, %s",
                    "and %s columns to match on position instead."),
              code(basename(as.character(p$path)[1])), code("panel_hit"), code("direct"),
              code("chrom"), code("start"), code("end"))
    }
  }

  note_span = function(key, body, shown) {
    sprintf('<span class="sv-panel-note" data-panel="%s"%s>%s</span>',
            htmltools::htmlEscape(key, attribute = TRUE),
            if (shown) "" else " hidden", body)
  }

  all_p    = if (!is.null(params$all_panels)) params$all_panels else list()
  selected = setdiff(as.character(unlist(params$default_panels)), "__all__")

  panel_note = paste(c(
    note_span("__none__",
              "No gene panel is ticked; tick one above to filter both tables.",
              length(selected) == 0),
    vapply(names(all_p), function(nm)
      note_span(nm, panel_body(all_p[[nm]]), nm %in% selected),
      character(1)),
    note_span("__custom__",
              paste("The custom list is bare symbols, so its SVs are matched on the",
                    "annotated breakend genes only — no positional window."),
              FALSE),
    note_span("__multi__",
              sprintf(paste("With more than one panel ticked a row is kept if it hits",
                            "<strong>any</strong> of them, and each %s entry ends with the",
                            "panel it matched in square brackets."), code("panel_hit")),
              length(selected) >= 2)
  ), collapse = " ")

  # Per caller: which VCF, how many records collapsed to how many rows, where the breakend genes
  # came from and how many rows they reached
  sv_prov   = SECTION_DATA$sv$callers
  caller_lab = c(severus = "Severus", savana = "SAVANA")
  lab = function(nm) if (nm %in% names(caller_lab)) caller_lab[[nm]] else nm
  fmt_n = function(x) formatC(as.integer(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
  caller_note = function(nm) {
    p = sv_prov[[nm]]
    rows = sv_table[caller == nm]
    if (nrow(rows) == 0 && is.null(p$vcf))
      return(sprintf("<strong>%s</strong>: no somatic SV VCF found.", lab(nm)))
    n_tr = sum(rows$svclass == "translocation"); n_in = sum(rows$svclass == "intra-chr breakend")
    src = if (!is.null(p$vcf))
      sprintf("%s rearrangement%s from the %s record%s of %s%s (%s interchromosomal, %s intra-chromosomal breakend%s).",
              fmt_n(nrow(rows)), if (nrow(rows) == 1) "" else "s",
              fmt_n(p$n_records), if (p$n_records == 1) "" else "s", code(rel(p$vcf)),
              if (isTRUE(p$pon_filtered)) ", the panel-of-normals-filtered calls the pipeline fed downstream" else "",
              fmt_n(n_tr), fmt_n(n_in), if (n_in == 1) "" else "s")
    else sprintf("%s rows from the gene-annotated TSV %s (no caller VCF).",
                 fmt_n(nrow(rows)), code(rel(p$gene_tsv)))
    genes = if (!is.null(p$annotation_path) && !is.null(p$vcf))
      sprintf("Breakend genes from %s, joined on record ID: %s of %s rows have an annotation record, %s carry a gene symbol.",
              code(rel(p$annotation_path)), fmt_n(p$n_annotated), fmt_n(nrow(rows)),
              fmt_n(p$n_with_genes))
    else if (!is.null(p$annotation_path)) ""
    else "No VEP SV annotation was found for it, so its gene columns are empty."
    rescued = if (isTRUE(p$n_rescued > 0))
      sprintf(paste("%s of these rows (in italics, hidden until the box above the table is ticked) are",
                    "<strong>whitelist-rescued</strong> (%s): calls that failed Severus' own filters and were kept",
                    "only because they lie in the %s regions — %s with a single supporting read, %s with a",
                    "non-PASS %s, shown in that column. They are not counted in the overview's SV card and are",
                    "left out of the genome circos; ShatterSeek and ReConPlot were given every call."),
              fmt_n(p$n_rescued), code("INFO/WL_RESCUE"), code("--severus_whitelist"),
              fmt_n(p$n_rescued_1read), fmt_n(p$n_rescued_fail), code("FILTER"))
    else ""
    failed = if (isTRUE(p$n_failed > 0))
      sprintf("%s record%s with a non-PASS %s and no whitelist rescue %s left out, as small variants are.",
              fmt_n(p$n_failed), if (p$n_failed == 1) "" else "s", code("FILTER"),
              if (p$n_failed == 1) "is" else "are")
    else ""
    typed = if (isTRUE(p$n_typed > 0))
      sprintf(paste("SAVANA writes every rearrangement as a %s mate pair; %s same-chromosome pairs",
                    "are typed here from %s (%s DEL, %s DUP, %s/%s INV) and treated as spans like",
                    "Severus' own DEL/DUP/INV — sized, 100 kb panel window, no breakend arc.",
                    "The hidden %s column keeps %s. Its VAF is %s at the first breakend."),
              code("BND"), fmt_n(p$n_typed), code("BP_NOTATION"), code("+-"), code("-+"),
              code("++"), code("--"), code("svtype_raw"), code("BND"), code("TUMOUR_AF"))
    else if (nm == "savana") sprintf("Its VAF is %s at the first breakend.", code("TUMOUR_AF"))
    else ""
    paste0("<strong>", lab(nm), "</strong>: ", paste(c(src, genes, rescued, failed, typed), collapse = " "))
  }
  callers_note = paste(vapply(names(sv_prov), caller_note, character(1)), collapse = "<br>")
  multi_note = if (length(unique(sv_table$caller)) > 1)
    sprintf(paste("<br>Both callers' calls are listed, so one rearrangement can appear twice —",
                  "filter on %s. The breakend circos above follows that filter (an arc per",
                  "visible breakend row, whichever caller); the genome-wide circos draws %s only."),
            code("caller"), lab(SECTION_DATA$sv$circos_caller))
  else ""

  pad = SECTION_DATA$sv$padfoot
  padfoot_note = if (isTRUE(SECTION_DATA$sv$has_padfoot)) {
    parts = vapply(names(pad), function(nm) {
      x = pad[[nm]]
      how = if (is.na(x$key)) "matched no row"
            else if (x$key == "locus") "matched on breakend coordinates only — no SV ID agreed, so check a few rows"
            else paste("joined on", x$key)
      sprintf("%s rows from %s (%s Padfoot rows): %s, %s of %s rows annotated.",
              lab(nm), code(rel(x$path)), fmt_n(x$n_padfoot), how, fmt_n(x$n_joined), fmt_n(x$n_rows))
    }, character(1))
    sprintf(paste("<br>The %s columns are Padfoot's: %s Callers without a Padfoot file have them",
                  "empty. %s is Padfoot's own impact class (%s values are tinted), not VEP's."),
            code("padfoot_*"), paste(parts, collapse = " "), code("padfoot_impact"), code("HIGH*"))
  } else ""

  annot_note = paste0(callers_note, multi_note, padfoot_note)

  # The locus/size convention: a contiguous type is one span, a breakend two joined loci
  locus_note = sprintf(paste("%s reads as a span (%s) for a contiguous type and as two",
                             "joined loci (%s or %s) for a breakend, which is also why %s",
                             "is blank for a breakend: its two loci bound no interval, so",
                             "there is no length to report. The underlying %s columns are",
                             "hidden rather than dropped — they are still what the panel",
                             "filter matches on, and the copy and CSV buttons still export",
                             "them. %s merges both sides for a contiguous type and labels",
                             "them %s and %s for a breakend, where which partner carries",
                             "which gene is the point."),
                       code("locus"), code("chr13:48,303,151–48,915,700"),
                       code("→"), code("↔"), code("size"),
                       paste(code("chrom_a"), code("pos_a"), code("chrom_b"),
                             code("pos_b"), sep = ", "),
                       code("genes"), code("A:"), code("B:"))

  # What the circos shows, only when there is a plot
  circos_note = if (!is.null(bnd_res) && !is.null(bnd_res$data))
    sprintf(paste("The circos above draws one arc per breakend with both loci mapped, and",
                  "is redrawn whenever the filter changes — it shows only the chromosomes",
                  "the visible rows touch, out of the %d these %d arc%s span in total.",
                  "Gene bodies are the panel genes within %s of a breakend — the same test",
                  "that fills the %s column, so a gene is drawn exactly when a visible row",
                  "names it, and a panel carrying no coordinates draws none. Bodies are",
                  "markers at a minimum visible width, not spans to scale."),
            length(bnd_res$chroms), bnd_res$n_links,
            if (bnd_res$n_links == 1) "" else "s",
            fmt_bp(SV_PANEL_WINDOW_BND), code("panel_hit"))
  else NULL
  if (!is.null(circos_note) && isTRUE(bnd_rescued_left_out > 0))
    circos_note = paste(circos_note, sprintf(paste("With every row there would be more arcs than it can",
                                                   "draw, so the %s whitelist-rescued breakends have no arc."),
                                             fmt_n(bnd_rescued_left_out)))

  table_details(
    summary = "How these rows and this plot are built",
    HTML(paste(
      sprintf("%s row%s, one per rearrangement — both callers write each side of a breakend as its own record, and mate pairs are collapsed here.",
              fmt_n(nrow(sv_table)), if (nrow(sv_table) == 1) "" else "s"),
      paste0(annot_note, "<br>"), locus_note, panel_note, circos_note))
  )
}
```

```{r sv-panel-notes-js, results='asis'}
# Show the notes for the ticked panels; defined here because the spans are written above
cat(r"----(<script>
window.updatePanelNotes = function () {
  var active = (window.svPanelState && window.svPanelState.panels) || [];
  document.querySelectorAll(".sv-panel-note").forEach(function (el) {
    var key = el.getAttribute("data-panel");
    if (key === "__none__")       el.hidden = active.length > 0;
    else if (key === "__multi__") el.hidden = active.length < 2;
    else                          el.hidden = active.indexOf(key) < 0;
  });
};
</script>
)----")
```
